title: Order Of The Fallen
author: PentemSully
description: In "Order Of The Fallen", you play as Anseil, a boy found in a monastery garden outside medieval Paris and raised by the Brothers as a scribe. Your quiet life changes when one day you are introduced to the mysterious Monsieur Procel and his pages of strange love letters -- all written backwards. From there, you are drawn into a world of angels, demons, magic, and deceit in which you must fight to survive...
